it: \bIo sono pronto, se lo sei anche tu.

id: \bRoark: Glad to see you made it. Welcome to my gym.
en: \bRoark: Glad to see you made it. Welcome to my gym.
it: \bPedro: Sono contento che tu sia arrivato. Benvenuto nella mia Palestra.

id: \bAs a Gym Leader my job is to test your strength, as well as your strategy. Prepare yourself. This won't be easy.
en: \bAs a Gym Leader my job is to test your strength, as well as your strategy. Prepare yourself. This won't be easy.
it: \bCome Capopalestra il mio compito è mettere alla prova la tua forza e la tua strategia. Preparati. Non sarà facile.
\bPedro: Ti sei guadagnato la Medaglia Carbone.

id: \bTM39 contains Head Smash. It's a powerful move, but it damages your Pokémon in return.
en: \bTM39 contains Head Smash. It's a powerful move, but it damages your Pokémon in return.
it: \bLa MT39 contiene Zuccata. È una mossa potente, ma in cambio danneggia anche il tuo Pokémon.

id: \bI would suggest you go to Eterna City for your next battle. You can get there going north from Jubilife City.
en: \bI would suggest you go to Eterna City for your next battle. You can get there going north from Jubilife City.
it: \bTi consiglio di andare a Evopoli per la tua prossima lotta. Ci arrivi andando a nord da Giubilopoli.

id: \bRoark: My father runs a Gym in Sinnoh here too. He's much stronger than me.
en: \bRoark: My father runs a Gym in Sinnoh here too.  He's much stronger than me.
it: \bPedro: Anche mio padre gestisce una Palestra qui a Sinnoh.  È molto più forte di me.

id: \bRoark uses Rock type Pokémon. They are weak aganst Water, Grass, Fighting, Ground, and Steel types.
en: \bRoark uses Rock type Pokémon. They are weak aganst Water, Grass, Fighting, Ground, and Steel types.
it: \bPedro usa Pokémon di tipo Roccia. Sono deboli contro i tipi Acqua, Erba, Lotta, Terra e Acciaio.

id: \bDespite all the weaknesses, they are strong against Fire, Bug, Flying, and Ice. Normal and Poison moves also don't do much damage.
en: \bDespite all the weaknesses, they are strong against Fire, Bug, Flying, and Ice. Normal and Poison moves also don't do much damage.
it: \bNonostante tutte queste debolezze, sono forti contro Fuoco, Coleottero, Volante e Ghiaccio. Anche le mosse di tipo Normale e Veleno non fanno molti danni.

id: \bYou're pretty hot. Though nowhere near Roark.
en: \bYou're pretty hot. Though nowhere near Roark.
it: \bSei proprio in gamba. Anche se non sei nemmeno lontanamente al livello di Pedro.
